information_architecture.navigation_model: Top-level app bar with sidebar category filtering and modal details overlay
views: VIEW-DASHBOARD: High-level SDLC status and task velocity
VIEW-TASK-EDITOR: Granular vertical slice creator and inspector
VIEW-EVAL-REPORT: AI decomposition benchmark results and scorecards

steps.action: User opens task creator input form
User submits task title and tags
System validates against RFC 7807 problem constraints
System triggers AI decomposition and displays live progress
User selects task slice from dashboard
System displays test results, contract schema, and audit trail

design_preferences.color_system: HSL tailored slate-cyan palette with dark-mode support
design_preferences.typography: Inter (sans-serif) for UI / JetBrains Mono for code blocks
design_preferences.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA minimum contrast and full keyboard operability
restrictions: No critical actions without explicit confirmation modal

design_assumptions.assumption: Adopt tailored slate-cyan HSL palette with WCAG AAA contrast
design_assumptions.rationalization: User did not specify a brand color hex; standardizing on accessible slate-cyan theme.

design_assumptions.assumption: Use modern sans-serif typography (Inter) with monospace code accents
design_assumptions.rationalization: Optimizes readability across desktop and mobile screens.

design_assumptions.assumption: Micro-animations capped at 250ms with accessible motion suppression
design_assumptions.rationalization: Ensures snappy interaction without triggering motion sensitivity.

wireframe.header: Top navigation bar with workspace switcher and SDLC health indicator
wireframe.sidebar: Filter by tags, status (todo, in-progress, completed), and assigned agent
wireframe.main_content: Task creation form followed by responsive task grid cards
wireframe.footer: System status bar displaying contract verification hash and active gates

error_handling.network_failure: Displays persistent offline banner with cached task access
error_handling.validation_error: Inline red banner mapping RFC 7807 error detail to input field
error_handling.empty_state: Renders empty state illustration with single CTA to create first task

responsive_adaptations.mobile: Single column layout, collapsible filters, bottom action sheet
responsive_adaptations.desktop: Multi-column dashboard with persistent sidebar and real-time activity stream

wireframe.header: Breadcrumbs navigation with back-to-dashboard CTA and status pill
wireframe.main_content: Split panel: left side shows task specification; right side shows verification evidence
wireframe.footer: Execution toolbar with rollback button, re-verify CTA, and delete action

error_handling.network_failure: Retry button with exponential backoff indicator
error_handling.validation_error: Detailed RFC 7807 dialog with stack trace and spec cross-reference
error_handling.empty_state: Placeholder card: "No AI evaluation benchmark recorded yet."

responsive_adaptations.mobile: Tabbed interface alternating between Specification and Verification evidence
responsive_adaptations.desktop: Side-by-side synchronized scroll view with active gate checklist

components.name: Task Creator Input Form
components.description: Primary input component for creating and decomposing new tasks

initial.description: Input field idle with placeholder "Describe feature to decompose..."

loading.description: Disabled submit button with animated spinner; opacity 0.7

success.description: Green highlight ring, input cleared, toast notification displayed

empty.description: Default placeholder rendered; validation message hidden

error.description: Red border (status.error), RFC 7807 error detail displayed below input

partial.description: Title validated locally; remote AI tags pending background fetch

offline.description: Offline warning badge; input disabled with "Offline mode" notice

destructive.description: Clear form warning dialog if dirty state exists

behavior.on_mount: Focus input if URL parameter autofocus=true is present
behavior.on_error: Scroll to error message and announce via aria-live="assertive"
behavior.validation: Trim whitespace, check non-empty and length <= 255 characters

accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Tab accessible, Enter submits, Esc clears current input

responsive_behavior.mobile: Full width stacked layout, button below input
responsive_behavior.desktop: Inline horizontal flex layout with integrated submit button

components.name: Task Card Grid
components.description: Interactive list and card grid rendering active task slices

initial.description: Renders cached task items in chronological order

loading.description: 3 animated skeleton cards with pulse animation

success.description: Renders complete list of task cards with green status badges

empty.description: Empty state illustration with text: "No tasks yet. Create one above."

error.description: Error banner with "Failed to load tasks" and retry button

partial.description: Cached tasks rendered with top banner indicating sync in progress

offline.description: Read-only view of cached tasks with offline notice banner

destructive.description: Task deletion animates card fade-out and slide-up

behavior.on_mount: Fetch task entities and subscribe to background synchronization
behavior.on_error: Render fallback cached items with retry CTA
behavior.validation: Validate each task entity structure before rendering

accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Arrow up/down to navigate tasks; Enter opens details

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column vertical stack of cards

components.name: Task Status Pill
components.description: Visual indicator displaying lifecycle status (todo, in_progress, completed)

loading.description: Pulsing blue pill indicating task execution active

success.description: Solid green pill indicating passing tests and verified evidence

error.description: Red pill indicating quality gate failure or contract drift

partial.description: Amber pill indicating partially verified vertical slice

offline.description: Dashed border pill indicating offline status

destructive.description: Red outline pill with delete icon

behavior.on_mount: Render status color corresponding to entity.status
behavior.validation: Check status is one of canonical lifecycle statuses

accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Non-interactive or focusable with tooltip description

components.name: AI Evaluation Benchmark Card
components.description: Inspects AI tool decomposition benchmarks, accuracy score, and latency

loading.description: Progress bar simulating live evaluation dataset execution

success.description: Pass badge with score > threshold (e.g. 95% pass rate)

empty.description: Notice: "No evaluation runs recorded for this task"

error.description: Red scorecard with failing prompts highlighted

behavior.on_mount: Load latest eval-runner JSON report for active feature

accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Tab to inspect individual prompt details

responsive_behavior.desktop: Multi-column grid displaying Accuracy, P95 Latency, and Cost

components.name: Destructive Confirmation Modal
components.description: Modal barrier preventing accidental task deletion or scope alteration

loading.description: Delete button disabled with spinner during HTTP DELETE

error.description: Error message within modal if delete request fails

partial.description: Disabled if user lacks deletion authority

offline.description: Blocked with notice: "Cannot delete tasks in offline mode"

destructive.description: Prominent red "Delete Permanently" button with double confirmation

behavior.on_error: Render error banner and keep modal open for retry
behavior.validation: Require user to type task ID or click explicit confirm button

accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Focus trapped; Esc dismisses; Tab cycles Cancel and Delete buttons

responsive_behavior.desktop: Centered overlay dialog with darkened backdrop
